projects.title: Digital PFM Reform Stories: Continental Country Experiences
projects.subtitle: A BNS Studios Continental Production · In Partnership with CABRI
projects.briefChallenge: Documenting real-world digital public financial management (GFPn) transformations, institutional bottlenecks, and transparency gains across 10 African nations.
projects.whatWeProduced: Pan-African bilingual documentary production featuring an interactive dual-language video player (English & Français), country case studies, and digital reform matrices.
projects.description: Produced under BNS Studios in strategic partnership with the Collaborative Africa Budget Reform Initiative (CABRI), this flagship continental production documents peer-learning and digital PFM breakthroughs across Anglophone and Francophone Africa. From Kenya's REFORMiS and Rwanda's Smart IFMIS to Benin's e-procurement and Côte d'Ivoire's SIGFiP, the production captures how ministries of finance are deploying digital architectures to build resilient, transparent public financial systems.

projects.title: Illicit Financial Flows & Sovereign Resource Governance
projects.subtitle: A Wanahabari Lab Forensic Investigation · In Partnership with House of Fiscal Wisdom
projects.briefChallenge: Investigating how trade misinvoicing, tax haven secrecy, and unmonitored maritime extractive agreements drain sovereign revenue from Benin and Cabo Verde.
projects.whatWeProduced: Forensic research video dossier led by Dr. Lyla Latif, legal framework analysis, and open-source citizen contract investigation tools.
projects.description: Conducted under BNS Wanahabari Lab in conjunction with the House of Fiscal Wisdom, Dr. Lyla Latif delivers an empirical forensic briefing exposing how multinational resource extraction contracts systematically disguise capital flight as allowable business expense deductions. Tied to the investigative monograph 'Red Flags in Government Contracts', this production equips civil society with actionable methodologies to detect revenue bleeding before long-term sovereign concessions are finalized.
outputs: West African Maritime Fiscal Concession Map

impactEvidence.context: Mobilizing parliamentary budget committees and investigative journalists against transfer mispricing.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: House of Fiscal Wisdom & Wanahabari Lab Research Dossier.

projects.title: Project TERRA: Technology, Equality, Regulatory Risk Assessment
projects.subtitle: In conjunction with House of Fiscal Wisdom & Luminate
projects.briefChallenge: Expose how platform architectures, algorithms, and tax concessions systematically render African women workers invisible in public revenue systems.
projects.whatWeProduced: Flagship research documentary film, verbatim transcript intelligence archive, interactive data maps, and regulatory sandbox framework.
projects.description: Hosted by the House of Fiscal Wisdom and led by Dr. Lyla Latif with funding from Luminate, Project TERRA establishes an empirical 5-mechanism framework interrogating algorithmic gender bias, data center tax holidays, and proactive regulatory sandbox models across Africa.
outputs: Data Centre Risk Assessment Sandbox (Kenya pilot)

impactEvidence.context: Anchoring fiscal reform for platform domestic workers and tech infrastructure across Africa.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: House of Fiscal Wisdom & Luminate research governance archive.

projects.title: Budget Sasa ni Delivery
projects.subtitle: National budget explainer series
projects.briefChallenge: Translate FY2026/27 national budget priorities into language young citizens could share on social feeds without losing fiscal accuracy.
projects.whatWeProduced: A presenter-led explainer package with bilingual cut-downs, chapter markers, and caption-ready vertical exports.
projects.description: BNS Studios produced a flagship explainer anchoring Treasury's 'delivery' narrative to verifiable allocation lines. Field segments from town halls were intercut with motion graphics built from National Treasury published tables  --  no synthetic scaling of figures.

impactEvidence.primaryMetric: 480K+ views across YouTube and social in 90 days
impactEvidence.context: Distribution through BNS Connect youth network and partner civic pages.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: View counts aggregated from platform analytics dashboards.
